chunks: Offering condolences to the family of the afflicted after the burial.

key_terms.أَهْلِ: the family or people closely connected to the deceased
key_terms.اَلتَّعْزِيَةُ: offering condolences and comforting the bereaved
key_terms.اَلْمُصِيبَةِ: the affliction or calamity of bereavement

ai.seo_question: Is it recommended to offer condolences to the bereaved family after burial?
ai.summary: This text concerns offering condolences to the family of one who has suffered a loss after the deceased has been buried. It indicates a social and ethical practice connected to death and mourning.
